params.name: id
params.desc: 要移除的灯光 id；省略会移除所有受 lightTool 管理的灯

code: const id = 'main'; ssp.lightTool.createAmbientLight({ id, color: '#ffffff', intensity: 0.5 }); const removed = ssp.lightTool.removeLight(id); if (removed < 1) throw new Error('light not found: ' + id); console.log('removed light', id, removed);
guard: 模板会先创建测试灯 main 再删除,确保可独立执行；业务调用应显式传 id，避免误删全部灯光
